# Aesthetic Success Network

> A membership network for aesthetic practice owners (dermatology, plastic
> surgery, med spas, estheticians, injectors) that pairs an Expert Hotline
> with member-only partner deals, a curated resource library of expert
> kits, and monthly live AMAs and CE. Each member problem gets a written
> action plan, by text and email, within 2 to 3 business days.
> Powered by Business of Aesthetics. Operated by Ekwa Marketing Inc.

## What it is

- Membership-based, not lead-gen. Members pay $29/month (founding) or
  $99/month (standard) for ongoing access. The membership is the
  product: no upsell into a coaching contract.
- The Expert Hotline is the differentiator: leave a voicemail with any
  practice problem in plain English and get a written action plan plus
  3 to 4 recommended experts to contact within 2 to 3 business days.
  The Hotline is a voicemail line answered in writing, AI-assisted; it
  is not a live or 24/7 helpline.
- Partners commit to a genuine member-only discount, at least as good
  as any offer they make comparable customers, and are listed with a
  Verified Partner badge. Members deal with partners directly. No
  per-deal commissions.
- A growing resource library of expert kits (training video, action
  guide, checklist, worksheet, slide deck) across Pricing & Margins,
  Consult & Conversion, Team & Culture, Patient Experience, Marketing &
  Growth, and Operations & Compliance. New kits are added weekly.
- Monthly live AMAs and CE with the network's experts.
- Every expert and partner is curated by the Business of Aesthetics
  team, never by an algorithm. There is no member directory and no
  member-to-member community; the in-portal feed carries updates from
  the network's experts and partners.

## For whom

- **Members**: owners and decision-makers at aesthetic practices
  (dermatologists, plastic surgeons, med spa owners, estheticians,
  injectors, practice managers).
- **Experts**: coaches, consultants and educators serving aesthetic
  practices who want a done-for-you content library and warm leads
  without running their own marketing funnel.
- **Partners**: companies serving aesthetic practices (injectables and
  pharmaceuticals, devices and equipment, skincare and product lines,
  practice-management software, marketing, patient financing, staffing,
  coaching, continuing education, accounting).

## Pricing

- Founding member: $29/month or $290/year. First 100 members only. Rate
  locked for as long as membership stays active.
- Standard member: $99/month or $990/year after the founding cap.
- 30-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime, no retention contract.
- Experts and partners: $0 for months 1 to 6, $39/month for months 7 to
  12, $199/month ($1,990/year) from month 13. Experts keep 70% of paid
  course revenue. Referral: $50 per referred member, paid after their
  first payment.
- Detailed pricing: https://www.aestheticsuccessnetwork.com/pricing.md

## Differentiators

- One membership is the product; no four-figure programs behind the
  door.
- Written action plans, routed by fit, never pay-to-play.
- Experts, partners and kits curated by the Business of Aesthetics team
  and the founding team (Naren Arulrajah, Founder & CEO, Ekwa Marketing;
  Lester De Alwis, Co-Founder, Aesthetic Success Network), not by an
  algorithm.
- Worked examples on the site are labelled illustrative. No unsourced
  savings figures are published.
